metadataRaw.title: Low Back Pain? Release the QL MUSCLE!
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to target one of the main causes of lower back pain: the quadratus lumborum (aka QL muscle).

If you're dealing with a lot of low back pain—especially off to one side—definitely check this video out. It could be a real backsaver!
